name: evident-charts
description: Helps coding agents make clear, honest charts and review them with the checks their tools support.

defaultPrompt: Critique this chart and list fixes.
Chart this CSV to show the main trend.
interface.longDescription: Create and improve explanatory charts for reports, slides, articles, and social posts. Evident Charts helps coding agents choose a chart, check the data, and review the result. It includes checks for matplotlib and SVG exports from other chart libraries. Python is needed to run the checks; SVG layout checks also need Chrome. When a tool is unavailable, the agent reports which checks it skipped.
